title: Psyren TV Anime Reveals Ending Song by Who-ya Extended
content: The anime will debut on Tokyo MX and BS11 on October 5 at 11:00 p.m., before airing later that evening on Sun TV . Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide excluding Japan and China.
author: ANN

title: Manchuria Opium Squad Manga Resumes Serialization With New Artist Tsurushima
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for writer Tsukasa Monma and the late artist Shikako 's Manchuria Opium Squad manga announced on Monday that the manga will resume in this year's 45th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine , which will ship on October 5.
author: ANN

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Manga Gets TV Anime in April
content: An X (formerly Twitter ) account opened on Monday to announce that a television anime of Kashiko Amane 's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret ( Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ) manga will premiere next April.
author: ANN

title: Web Manga 'Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru' Gets TV Anime in Spring 2027
content: Production company Starry Cube opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Kashiko Amane 's Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru ( Everyone's Darling Has a Secret ) web manga on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Stranger Than Heaven Game Streams In-Depth Video Highlighting 'Showbiz'
content: Sega began streaming an in-depth "showbiz" video for Ryu ga Gotoku Studio's Stranger Than Heaven game (previously codenamed "Project Century") on Friday. The video provides a detailed overview of finding musical inspiration, creating songs, and promoting shows in the game.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Brings Back Jinwoo’s Major Opponent in a New Story
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Solo Leveling webtoon! There’s still a while before Solo Leveling returns with its anticipated movie to continue the story after the Jeju Island Arc. The second season ended last year after wrapping up one of the best arcs in the series.
author: ComicBook

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Disappoints Fans With Steel Ball Run Return & Here’s Why
content: Now that the Fall 2026 anime season is already here, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run made its anticipated return after its controversial premiere episode in March this year. Netflix was under fire for several months regarding the unsatisfying schedule, especially since fans were expecting a weekly release.
author: ComicBook

title: Tetsuya Chiba Puts Hinemosu Notari Nikki Manga on Hiatus Due to Poor Health
content: This year's 19th issue of Shogakukan 's Big Comic magazine announced on Friday that Tetsuya Chiba 's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will go on hiatus due to Chiba's poor health. title: Sankaku Head Reveals New Himouto! Umaru-chan Manga
content: Sankaku Head announced in a livestream on the Niconico streaming service on Saturday that he will launch Umaru-chan 100 , a new series in the Himouto! Umaruchan manga, on Shueisha 's Young Jump + platform on October 1. Sankaku Head launched the original Himouto!

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Premieres in U.S. on October 8
content: The Japan Society announced on Sunday that that it will host the U.S. premiere of Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) in collaboration with CloverWorks and Aniplex of America in New York City on October 8.
author: ANN
